recipes.title: Generate a new decomposition
recipes.description: Naming the abstraction level avoids an additional selection step.
recipes.prompt: Create a multi-level functional decomposition for an autonomous warehouse robot that retrieves totes in shared pedestrian aisles.

recipes.title: Inspect one subsystem
recipes.description: Returns the functions and interfaces already present in the active project.
recipes.prompt: Show the functions and interfaces allocated to the Perception subsystem in the current project.

recipes.title: Check graph connectivity
recipes.description: Inspects the existing decomposition without changing it.
recipes.prompt: Check the current functional decomposition for orphan node pairs, isolated functions, and disconnected graph islands.

recipes.title: Propose connections for orphan pairs
recipes.description: Creates reviewable bridging rows; say “add them” only after checking the proposal.
recipes.prompt: Find orphan node pairs in the current functional decomposition and propose interface rows that connect them to the main functional graph.

title: Review and revise the active decomposition

recipes.title: Score decomposition quality
recipes.description: Applies the same weighted engineering rubric to the complete active table and returns row-referenced findings.
recipes.prompt: Review and score the current project’s functional decomposition for hazard-analysis readiness.

recipes.title: Revise from the quality review
recipes.description: Uses the exact scored findings from this thread to prepare changes that remain subject to your approval.
recipes.prompt: Revise the current functional decomposition using this quality review.

recipes.title: Run an additive completeness audit
recipes.description: Looks for missing coverage while preserving every existing row.
recipes.prompt: Audit the current functional decomposition for missing operational, feedback, health, mode, and fault-management interfaces. Preserve every existing row and propose additions only.

recipes.title: Revise from engineering feedback
recipes.description: Produces targeted additions, updates, and removals for review.
recipes.prompt: Revise the current functional decomposition based on this feedback: [describe the specific problem and desired correction]. Preserve sound unrelated rows and prepare targeted changes for review.

recipes.title: Reevaluate subsystem ownership
recipes.description: Reviews allocation without rewriting the interfaces.
recipes.prompt: Reevaluate the subsystem allocation for every existing functional decomposition row. Do not add, remove, or rewrite interfaces.

recipes.title: Request an explicit table edit
recipes.description: Use exact function and payload names whenever possible.
recipes.prompt: Add a feedback interface from Monitor Brake Status to Determine Braking Availability carrying Secondary Brake Health Status. Preserve unrelated rows.

recipes.title: Vibe review each interface
recipes.description: Walks a stable queue one row at a time and proposes Keep, Revise, Remove, or Needs Input.
recipes.prompt: Vibe review the current functional decomposition one interface at a time. Check leaf-function endpoints, subsystem ownership, direction, interface semantics, and details.

recipes.title: Vibe review one subsystem
recipes.description: Limits the queue to an exact subsystem name.
recipes.prompt: Vibe review functional-decomposition rows in subsystem Perception & World Modeling one interface at a time.

recipes.title: Vibe Review Needs Review rows
recipes.description: Creates a stable queue and presents one governed Yes/No proposal at a time.
recipes.prompt: Vibe review the current project’s hazard-analysis rows where Safety Significance is marked Needs Review. Review them one at a time, briefly explain each row, and propose Yes or No.

recipes.title: Resolve shared evidence gaps in batch
recipes.description: Opens the grouped architecture-question workflow when many unresolved rows depend on the same missing evidence.
recipes.prompt: Help me resolve the remaining Needs Review hazard rows in batch using grouped architecture evidence questions.

recipes.title: Challenge existing Yes classifications
recipes.description: Useful for finding false positives after the initial analysis.
recipes.prompt: Vibe review the current project’s hazard-analysis rows where Safety Significance is marked Yes. Review them one at a time. Propose retaining Yes or changing it to No using only the documented causal path and physical-harm chain.

recipes.title: Ask an evidence-grounded question
recipes.description: Collaborator can explain the analysis without changing it.
recipes.prompt: Summarize the current project’s highest-priority safety-significant hazard-analysis results and include links to the supporting source rows.

recipes.title: Review a narrower hazard scope
recipes.description: Name an exact table field and value to avoid an ambiguous review queue.
recipes.prompt: Vibe review hazard-analysis rows where Subsystem Allocation is Perception & World Modeling. Review exactly one row at a time and propose Yes or No.

title: Work across the saved xHandle workspace

recipes.title: Ask across artifact families
recipes.description: Searches the workspace graph and links the answer to saved sources.
recipes.prompt: Across all projects, which requirements, hazard rows, safety issues, reports, and safety-case claims address unintended vehicle motion? Cite the saved sources.

recipes.title: Update a saved field
recipes.description: Shows the resolved source and exact proposed edit before anything changes.
recipes.prompt: Set the owner of the Secondary Brake Availability safety issue to Alex Chen and explain which saved record you found.

recipes.title: Add a record
recipes.description: Creates a governed proposal against the active project or named destination.
recipes.prompt: Add a proposed system requirement that the secondary brake health status be reported before autonomous motion is authorized.

recipes.title: Delete or undo
recipes.description: Deletes require an additional confirmation; approved Collaborator changes retain an undo snapshot.
recipes.prompt: Delete the duplicate hazard row titled "Stale localization state" from the current project. After applying it, say “undo that” if you want it restored.
